component.name: Handy
component.summary: Offline transcription for audio and video files

description.p: This is a community package of Handy, maintained independently. It installs the official upstream Linux build without changing its files.

Handy transcribes audio and video files locally using speech models you choose. The models run on your computer, and your recordings and transcripts are not sent to a transcription service. The app can also record from a microphone and transcribe speech as you go.

ul.li: Transcribe audio and video files into text and subtitles
Choose from Whisper and Parakeet models
Use Vulkan GPU acceleration when available, with CPU inference as a fallback
Download models on demand; they are not bundled with the app

description.p: Handy downloads models when you choose them, so the first use needs network access and free disk space. Models, settings and history remain in Flatpak's private app storage.

Selected files are opened through the desktop file chooser. To access a media folder directly, grant it with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/media com.pais.handy. Remove custom grants with flatpak override --user --reset com.pais.handy.

Audio and video file transcription is the focus of this package. Microphone recording is available in Handy but is not granted microphone access by default; enable it with flatpak override --user --socket=pulseaudio com.pais.handy.
Global shortcuts and typing into other applications depend on the desktop session and external input tools. They are not required to transcribe files.
Install application updates through Flatpak; the built-in updater cannot replace the read-only Flatpak application.
Initial FlatPark package based on Handy 0.10.1.
